current_vs_average.reason: Checkpoints store the average strategy only (no regrets), so the current strategy cannot be reconstructed. Use the distance to a previous checkpoint and the SBR proxy instead.

sbr.note: Proxy only, not exploitability. Gain = held-out response value minus held-out profile value for the responder seat. Negative gains mean the sampled response did not generalise to the validation deals.
